recipe.point_algebra: The unchanged rank-four tables, tensor order and weights in v28.
recipe.extension: Extend coefficients to Q(sqrt(2)); set xi_i=U_i/2+sqrt(2)*V_i/2 and eta_i=U_i/2-sqrt(2)*V_i/2.
recipe.subalgebra: For each listed guard factor f, use the span of square-exponent monomials whose bit vectors lie in subspace_basis. Order bit vectors numerically. Norm is the determinant of multiplication by f on this basis.
recipe.integer_descent: Conjugation stability makes each subalgebra norm rational. Integrality of the point generators makes it an integer polynomial; no extra variable or choice of a square root of 2 is introduced.
recipe.G: Product of the subalgebra norms, each factor once. G!=0 is equivalent to the former full scalar norm guard being nonzero at every rational retained tuple.
recipe.quadratic_tower: In point order use W_i, z_i=(2*A_i+B_i)*U_i-2*(A_i+B_i)*V_i, followed by the square-extracted pole roots.
recipe.r: 1+sum of squares of every retained coordinate (the extra separating variable is not included).
recipe.Omega: Sum over i of 2*M_i*q_i * (product_{k<i} c_k) * (product_{k>i} 4*M_k^2), where q_i is the tower generator and q_i^2=c_i.
recipe.P: det_A(I-Y*G*M_Omega) on the unchanged full finite algebra in the original v28 basis.
recipe.final: X*P for the two conditional routes, and P otherwise.
recipe.semantics: G=0 gives P=1 even on a nonreduced pole boundary. G!=0 gives exactly a rational character of the guarded v28 source. The inherited full-unit completeness theorem preserves every required integer input.
recipe.degree_convention: Total degree in retained coordinates and Y. Fixed family parameters are coefficients, not quantified variables.

arithmetic_scope: Exactly the v28 arithmetic source, assumptions, sufficient parameters and full-unit completeness theorem. No new arithmetic input.
coefficient_scope: L=20483 is a certified defining choice under the inherited premises.
